observed_reference_principles: Worked example followed by aggregate evidence
Serif vector-style charts and light grids
Sparse pale row shading in robustness matrix
not_observed_or_not_transferred: Reference tables do not systematically mark best and second best
Reference exact colors and font sizes were not measured
Reference scatter/frontier lines do not justify performance interpolation
No reference prose, identities, results or claims copied into ARC2

plot_decisions.font: LaTeX serif; maintain LNCS body layout
plot_decisions.alternative_scale_policy: If independent main-panel y limits are retained, label different y ranges next to panels and in caption. Any inset must retain all six methods and native references.
plot_decisions.uncertainty: No invented pooled bands; use all saved family-adjusted ablation intervals; keep zero, negative and unresolved controls.
candidate_annotations: Prospective MiniLM: 0.5195 at 75%, Full-Y 0.5203; point estimates, no equivalence claim

table_decisions.best: Bold best full-precision mean among six adapters in every comparable metric column
table_decisions.native: Separate block; preserve both native references; excluded from adapter ranks with explicit note
table_decisions.identity: ARC2 label bold; optional pale blue 4% row tint is a navigation cue, not winner encoding
table_decisions.precision: Four decimals uniformly; disclose rounded ties or increase entire relevant column precision
table_decisions.significance: Preserve exact dagger meaning from saved adjusted intervals; ranking is distinct from significance
table_decisions.headers: Migration spanners with cmidrules; budget/metric subheader above body midrule
table_decisions.gain: Signed absolute nDCG difference with named comparator; no selective percentage conversion

fairness_checks: DEV Recall best is Procrustes, second ARC2
MiniLM all-paid nDCG best point mean is ridge, ARC2 second; interval unresolved
All prospective adapter point winners must receive same emphasis
Keep all 30 prospective contrasts represented; unresolved is not equivalence
Keep native Full-X and Full-Y context
validation: Numeric CSV and saved interval equality before/after
Regenerate through evidence builder; no hand edits to generated tables
Compile standard LNCS without font/margin compression
Inspect every compiled page at print size and grayscale
Verify rank styling from unrounded means
Existing numerical/document QA and source ZIP smoke
